crosswalkFormat.name: RocKIT Repository Metadata Crosswalk
crosswalkFormat.description: A declarative, single-file schema inventory and reviewed mapping draft between canonical RO-Crate metadata, seven ARP profiles, seven Dataverse metadata blocks, and the complete Zenodo legacy deposition upload metadata schema. Unmatched fields remain explicitly unmapped.

canonicalModel.semanticKeyPolicy: Use a full property IRI only when it is declared by a source schema and verified as semantically portable.
canonicalModel.cardinalityPolicy: Preserve source multiplicity canonically; adapt cardinality only at repository boundaries.

placeholderPolicy.rationale: RO-Crate root identifiers and blank placeholders are not metadata values.

iriPolicy.sourceDeclaredRepositorySpecificIds: retain as provenance, not as canonical mappings
iriPolicy.unmatchedFields: record explicitly as source-only or target-only with a null mapping

provenance.dataverse: Cached Dataverse metadata blocks returned by /api/metadatablocks?returnDatasetFieldTypes=true.
provenance.caveat: The Zenodraft JSON Schema is unofficial. Official Zenodo documentation supplies required and conditional-required rules in this document.

documentModel.repositorySchema: Defines accepted fields, types, cardinalities, controlled vocabularies, and requirements.
documentModel.mapping: Connects canonical semantic properties to repository target fields.
documentModel.transformation: References a named operation in transformationLibrary; JSON never contains executable code.

omitEmpty.description: Omit null, undefined, blank strings, empty arrays, and empty objects.

omitValues.description: Omit configured placeholder values before target validation.

trim.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from strings.

firstNonEmpty.description: Select the first non-empty value from ordered source candidates.

first.description: Select the first item when the target is not repeatable.

asArray.description: Wrap a scalar as an array and preserve existing arrays.

normalizeDate.description: Normalize an ISO-like date to YYYY-MM-DD.

validateUrl.description: Accept only absolute URLs using configured schemes.

parseInteger.description: Convert a numeric-looking scalar to an integer.

parseNumber.description: Convert a numeric-looking scalar to a finite number.

mapVocabulary.description: Map source terms to the target controlled vocabulary.

resolveReferences.description: Resolve RO-Crate @id references against @graph before mapping.

mapEntities.description: Map resolved entities to target objects using nested field rules.
mapEntities.reversible: when every nested mapping is reversible

buildCompound.description: Construct a Dataverse compound-field object from canonical properties.
buildCompound.reversible: when every child mapping is reversible

flattenText.description: Flatten one or more text values into a single target string.

defaultValue.description: Apply a repository fallback only when no semantic source value exists.

filterByValue.description: Keep compound entities whose selected property matches a configured value.

inferResourceType.description: Infer a repository resource type from RO-Crate @type and content metadata.

deriveAccessRight.description: Derive Zenodo access_right from access conditions, embargo, and license metadata.

aggregateIdentifiers.description: Normalize identifiers and relations into a repository identifier array.

custom.description: Call a named, registered transformer for exceptional mappings.

pipeline: resolve source candidates and linked entities
validate types and cardinality against the embedded target schema
